title: Live socket frame, client to capture
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.2, #773), not implemented. The JSON header of one frame a client (the app as `reader`, a tool as `viewer`, the root reload helper) writes on capture's live socket. Two families by `t`: notices, which get no answer (`hello`, `poke`, `cursor`, `urgent_taken`, `paging_finished`), and `request`, which gets one `reply` (capture-socket-reply.schema.json). Capture skips a `t` it does not know and answers an `op` it does not know `unsupported`. Only a client that said `role` `reader` may make requests; `credentials` is taken from uid 0 alone. No request takes a path or a command line, and none returns a secret.

at.description: When the client made the frame, Unix seconds. For logs only: nothing is decided by it.

hello.title: hello
hello.description: The client's first frame: who it is.

role.description: `reader`: the app; it may make requests, and its connection is what the status reports as `reader.attached`. `viewer`: a status tool; its requests are answered `reason` `forbidden`. Self-declared: it keeps a tool from changing anything by mistake and is no defence.

contract.description: The capture contract's major version the client speaks, 1.

subscribe.description: The optional frames the client wants; [] or absent for none.

items.description: An optional frame's `t`. Capture ignores one it does not know.

poke.title: poke
poke.description: Look at something now instead of at the next poll.

what.description: What changed: `wish` (the wish file was written).

cursor.title: cursor
cursor.description: The spool cursor moved: capture may delete what is done. It reads `cursor.app.json` itself; the notice carries nothing.

urgent_taken.title: urgent_taken
urgent_taken.description: The app has taken that urgent file's rows up to `n` over into its own lane. Capture ignores a notice for another epoch than its file's, so an `n` from before a reset never marks new rows as taken.

urgent_epoch.description: The epoch `n` counts in, 16 hex characters.

n.description: Every row at or below this is taken.

urgent_delivered.title: urgent_delivered
urgent_delivered.description: The hub answered 200 for the app's take-over event that carries this key (all-in-one: the app's `cad.alarms` took it). The only way capture learns what the app's lane delivered: the row becomes `app`, the banner clears, and capture never sends it. A key capture does not hold is ignored.

gen.description: Optional: the hub's generation in its answer to that event. With it the row joins the resend rule; without it the row is never sent again.

paging_finished.title: paging_finished
paging_finished.description: The live page became a finished page (today's `LivePaging.finished`). Without it the live page ends on its own hold timeout.

end.description: When the page ended, Unix seconds.

request.title: request
request.description: A request: something imperative that needs an answer. Capture answers every request with one `reply` frame carrying the same `id`, on the same connection.

id.description: Chosen by the client, unique, 1 to 64 characters. Capture applies each id once and remembers the last 256 for 10 min (on the boot clock): a repeat gets the first reply again and changes nothing, even after its deadline. The person's yes to a refusal with `confirm` is a new request, under a new id, with `args.confirm` true.

op.description: What is asked. An op capture does not know is answered `ok` false, `reason` `unsupported`.

args.description: The op's arguments (`$defs/<op>`); {} for an op that has none.

by.description: Who asked: `person` (a click, on the station or through the hub).

expires_boot.description: The deadline, on CLOCK_BOOTTIME, seconds since boot (both ends are on one host). A request that reaches capture at or after it is answered `reason` `expired` and not applied; a stepped wall clock expires nothing.

args-pick.title: pick
args-pick.description: A person's pick of a dongle's job, or Off (today's `App.set_mode`).

job.description: The job: a channel's label, the P25 job, a system job, or `Off`.

confirm.description: The person said yes to the question a refusal with `confirm` true asked.

args-squelch_apply.title: squelch_apply
args-squelch_apply.description: Apply squelch values to a running channel (#685, #700); all four values are needed. With `expect` it is refused (`reason` `stale`) when what runs now is not what the suggestion was made for; without it, a plain set.

open_db.description: The squelch opens at this much quieting, dB.

close_db.description: The squelch closes below this much quieting, dB.

expect.title: What must be running
expect.description: The values the suggestion was made against.

open_db.description: The running `open_db` the client saw, dB.

close_db.description: The running `close_db` the client saw, dB.

args-reception_start.title: reception_start
args-reception_start.description: Start a reception test: the body of today's `reception_post`. Its keys are not typed here.

args-probe.title: probe
args-probe.description: Run the no-audio probe on a dongle now (`App._probe`). `result`: `audio` or `none`.

args-airband_ab.title: airband_ab
args-airband_ab.description: An on-air A/B comparison on one airband dongle (`App.airband_ab`).

minutes.description: How long the comparison runs, minutes; 0 stops a running one.

phase_s.description: How long each side is on before the switch, seconds.

args-check.title: check
args-check.description: Ask whether an edit would be refused, before the app writes it into the wish. Advisory only: it changes nothing, and capture validates again when it applies the wish.

value.description: The edit as it would be written into the wish: `dongles.groups` (a list) for `groups`, the reserved serial for `adsb`.

confirm.description: The person said yes to the question a refusal with `confirm` true asked.

args-urgent_since.title: urgent_since
args-urgent_since.description: The app's take-over after a reconnect: the urgent rows above its cursor, page by page. `result`: capture-socket-reply.schema.json `$defs/urgent-since-result`.

urgent_epoch.description: The epoch the app's cursor belongs to, 16 hex characters. When it is not the file's, capture answers from 0.

n.description: The app's cursor: rows above it are wanted. 0: from the start.

limit.description: The most rows in one reply.

memory_after.description: The memory items wanted are those after this `m` (the last reply's `memory_last`); 0 from the first, and 0 again after a new `pid` in `hello`.

args-credentials.title: credentials
args-credentials.description: The rotated credentials, handed over by the root reload helper (`systemctl reload sizeup-radio`). ACCEPTED ONLY FROM A PEER WHOSE UID IS 0 (SO_PEERCRED); anyone else is answered `forbidden`. All three are sent, "" for none. The only frame of the contract that carries a secret: never logged, and never kept in the memory of answered requests.

token.description: The station's own `sz1` token (SIZEUP_STATION_TOKEN); "" when the store has none.

access_id.description: The Cloudflare Access service token's client id; "" when the hub is not behind Access.

access_secret.description: The Cloudflare Access service token's secret; "" when the hub is not behind Access.

args-snapshot.title: snapshot
args-snapshot.description: Ask for the snapshot. No arguments. `result`: the snapshot (capture-socket-event.schema.json `$defs/snapshot`).
